romance.lastChangeReason: 主人公がCalebの前の言葉をわざわざ説明し直し、自分の手紙で彼を癒したいと率直に伝え、二人だけの『ウサギ』の冗談を続けたため、Calebにとって手紙そのものを待つ親しみと個人的な好感がはっきり強まった
romance.lastProgress: 主人公の手紙を待つようになったことを自分から認め、二人だけのウサギの冗談を発展させ、主人公の好みを具体的に知ろうとした

letters.text:
January, 10th, 2023

Dear. Mr. Caleb Ward

Nice to meet you.
I am an international student. I like rabbits, so please call me "Buchi Usagi🐰".

I'm studying English, but I'd be happy if I could write to you.

It's been cold lately.

Do you have anything warm over there?

January 16, 2023

Buchi Usagi,

Thanks for writing.

I wasn't sure anyone would actually pick my profile, so your letter was a surprise.

"Buchi Usagi" is a strange name, but all right. I'll use it.

We have heat here. Some days it works better than others. I've got a blanket and a sweatshirt, so I'm not freezing.

You said you're an international student and you're studying English. Your letter made sense to me. Don't worry too much about getting everything right.

Why rabbits?

Caleb

letters.text:
January, 22th, 2023

Dear. Mr. Caleb Ward.

Hello.
Thank you for your reply.
I rely on automatic translation. The translation may be strange. Please forgive me.
I'm glad you didn't feel cold.
As for rabbits, I kept rabbits at home when I was in elementary school.
It is a warm, fluffy, smart, and very healing animal.

I would be happy if I could do that too.

But I don't really like carrots.

Do you have any likes or dislikes?

I'm waiting for your reply.

Buchi Usagi.

January 29, 2023

Buchi Usagi,

Automatic translation doesn't bother me. If something comes out strange, I'll ask. That's easier than pretending I understood it.

Your explanation about rabbits made more sense than just saying you like them. Warm, fluffy, smart. I can see the appeal.

A rabbit person who doesn't like carrots, though. That's a little suspicious.

You asked what I like. Books, obviously. Cars too. I used to spend most of my days around engines, so I still miss working with my hands sometimes.

What I don't like? Being pushed to talk before I'm ready. And people who say things they don't mean.

There was one sentence I wasn't sure about: "I would be happy if I could do that too." Maybe the translation ate part of it. You can write it again if you want.

You said you're waiting for my reply. I noticed that.

What are you studying besides English?

Caleb

letters.text:
February, 10th, 2023

Dear Mr. Caleb Ward,

Hello.

I will answer your question.
私は貴方の質問にお答えします。

"I would be happy if I could do that too."
↓
I want to be a rabbit for you.
私は貴方にとってのうさぎになりたいです。
Rabbits heal people.
うさぎは人を癒します。
I hope my letter will cheer you up.
私の手紙が貴方に元気を与えてくれたら嬉しいです。
Think of it as a kind of animal therapy.
一種の動物療法と思ってください。
Please feed other than carrots. Something sweet...
餌はニンジン以外でお願いします。甘いものとか…。
Ah! Can you eat something sweet there?
あっ！そちらでは甘いものは食べられるのでしょうか？

May you always be calm.
貴方がいつも穏やかでありますように。
I'm waiting for your reply.
お返事待ってます。

Buchi Usagi

February 17, 2023

Buchi Usagi,

All right. Now I understand what you meant.

"I want to be a rabbit for you" is not a sentence I expected to get in the mail. I laughed. Quietly, before you get too proud of yourself.

If this is animal therapy by letter, it may be working. I won't make a big claim about it, but I do notice when enough days have passed that one of your letters might be coming.

And yes, we can get sweet things here sometimes. Cookies, candy, snack cakes. Depends on what's available. So your no-carrot diet is probably survivable.

If I'm supposed to be responsible for feeding this rabbit, though, you'd better tell me what kind of sweet things you actually like.

You also said you were going to answer my question, but you answered the older one. You still owe me this: what are you studying besides English?

And for the record, "May you always be calm" was a good thing to read here.

I'll be waiting for your answer too.

Caleb

Buchi Usagi,

segments.ja: 分かった。今度は意味が分かったよ。

segments.ja: 「貴方にとってのうさぎになりたい」なんて手紙でもらうとは思ってなかった。笑ったよ。静かにな。だからあまり得意になるな。

segments.en: If this is animal therapy by letter, it may be working. I won't make a big claim about it, but I do notice when enough days have passed that one of your letters might be coming.
segments.ja: これが手紙でやる動物療法なら、少しは効いてるのかもしれない。大げさなことは言わないが、そろそろ君の手紙が来る頃だなって日数を気にするようにはなった。

segments.en: And yes, we can get sweet things here sometimes. Cookies, candy, snack cakes. Depends on what's available. So your no-carrot diet is probably survivable.
segments.ja: それと、甘いものは時々食べられる。クッキー、キャンディ、甘い菓子パンみたいなものだ。何があるかはその時次第。だから、ニンジン抜きの食生活でもたぶん生きていける。

segments.en: If I'm supposed to be responsible for feeding this rabbit, though, you'd better tell me what kind of sweet things you actually like.
segments.ja: ただ、俺がこのウサギの餌係になるなら、君が実際にはどんな甘いものが好きなのか教えてもらわないとな。

segments.en: You also said you were going to answer my question, but you answered the older one. You still owe me this: what are you studying besides English?
segments.ja: それから、俺の質問に答えるって書いてたけど、答えたのは一つ前の方だったな。まだ一つ貸しがある。英語のほかには何を勉強してる？

segments.en: And for the record, "May you always be calm" was a good thing to read here.
segments.ja: あと、「いつも穏やかでありますように」って言葉は、ここで読むにはいい言葉だった。

segments.en: I'll be waiting for your answer too.
segments.ja: 今度は俺も君の返事を待ってる。

segments.en: Caleb
segments.ja: ケイレブ

共通恋愛ルールとPRISON恋愛ルールを必ず確認する
主人公の手紙がCalebにどう響いたかを判断し、romanceScore・trust等を必要に応じて維持・増減する
文通回数だけを理由に恋愛度や恋愛段階を上げない
恋愛度・信頼・性格・状況から自然な場合だけ恋愛段階を進める
恋愛度が上がっているのに無難な関係へ意図的に薄めない
返答本文とromance状態を一致させる
Calebの返事は英語で書き、自然な切れ目ごとに日本語訳を付ける
